title: Cyclotomic Galois Automorphism Witness Equivariance and Conjugation Constant-Term Projection
claims: Over R_q = Z_q[X]/(X^n + 1) (n = 2^k, q = 2^t), the n Galois automorphisms tau_u: X -> X^u (u odd in 1..2n-1) form an exact group homomorphism and act modulo 2 as pure coordinate permutations fixing degree 0.

Under complex conjugation tau_{2n-1}: X -> -X^{n-1}, summing f(X) + tau_{2n-1}(f)(X) via CNOT identically annihilates the midpoint degree-(n/2) coefficient across all f in R_q and projects palindromic polynomials onto 2*f_0 mod q.
favorable_controls: R_16[X]/(X^4+1) and R_32[X]/(X^8+1) group homomorphism and midpoint annihilation audits
